sources.snippet: The EfficientDet-Lite0 model uses an EfficientNet-Lite0 backbone with a 320x320 input size and BiFPN feature network. The model was trained with the COCO dataset, a large-scale object detection dataset that contains 1.5 million object instances and 80 object labels.

sources.title: EfficientDet Lite Object Detection with ONNX & TensorRT
sources.snippet: EfficientDet Lite Object Detection with ONNX & TensorRT is a high-performance project designed to implement EfficientDet Lite models (versions 0 to 4) for object detection. Utilizing ONNX for model inference and TensorRT for optimized engine building, this project enables efficient and rapid deployment of object detection models with support for FP32 and FP16 precision on NVIDIA GPUs.
